description:
List the human's own Dueback negotiation cases (newest first):
case_id, status, public bill-type label, counterparty, and amounts
for each. Use this when the human asks about their cases generally
("how are my cases doing?") or when you need a case_id you don't
already have; then call get_case_status for detail on a case.

If the result carries sign_in_required, the human is not signed in
and the empty cases list is NOT a report that they have no cases:
ask the human to sign in to Dueback, then call list_my_cases again.
A 401 is returned as this friendly result, not raised, so unauthenticated
probes (e.g. bots hitting the MCP endpoint without credentials) do not
surface as Sentry errors.
name: list_my_cases
title: List my cases
